learning_objective: 🎯 Master advanced word processing features in LibreOffice Writer / MS Word: styles, templates, tables of contents, and mail merge for professional document design!

key_vocabulary.hindi_meaning: मेल मर्ज (एक पत्र को कई लोगों को भेजना)
टेक्स्ट रैपिंग (चित्र के चारों ओर टेक्स्ट व्यवस्थित करना)

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Styles (Paragraph, Character, Frame, Page, List) apply consistent font, size, and color formatting across a document instantly. Use 'Fill Format Mode' to apply a style to multiple scattered items quickly.

main_concepts.concept_title: 🖼️ Working with Images and Drawing Objects
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Inserting images, resizing, cropping, and controlling how text flows around them using Text Wrapping settings (Page Wrap, Optimal Page Wrap, Wrap Through).
Templates save standardized layouts for reuse. An automated Table of Contents (TOC) is generated instantly from document heading styles (Heading 1, Heading 2), updating page numbers automatically.
A feature to create personalized letters, labels, or certificates for many recipients by merging a Main Document (static text) with a Data Source (recipient spreadsheet/database).

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Instant Makeover
fun_activity.instructions: Open a word processor and type three paragraphs. Highlight the title and apply the built-in 'Heading 1' style. Notice how font size, color, and spacing update simultaneously with a single click!

exam_tips: 📌 Memorize the 5 types of Styles in LibreOffice Writer: Paragraph, Character, Frame, Page, and List styles.
📌 Clearly define the two components required for a Mail Merge: 1) Main Document, and 2) Data Source.
📌 Know the difference between 'Cropping' an image (cutting off unwanted outer parts) and 'Resizing' (changing its dimensions).
quick_recap: ⭐ The automated Table of Contents relies entirely on Heading styles being applied correctly.
⭐ Templates use the extension `.ott` in LibreOffice Writer.
⭐ Mail merge saves hours of manual retyping when sending invitations or official notices to hundreds of people.
